lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 6 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments are visible on the lateral torso; spacing is approximately regular in the central torso with a wider gap between the first and second posterior lines.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A prominent Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the sixth line segment from the posterior, located at the mid-vertical level of the anterior torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The posterior-most line is abbreviated and terminates mid-flank; the anterior-most line near the shoulder transition is significantly shorter than the central four segments.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast circular white spots are visible on the lower haunch, vertically oriented relative to each other.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory with a spiral twist, originating at an obtuse angle from the frontal bone, bowing laterally, and then converging toward the medial plane at the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 2.2 times the width of the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The ivory-colored (high-contrast) tips represent approximately 15-20% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: White chevron marking between the eyes; two white spots on the lower cheek; white patch on the lower throat; orange-tan coloration on all four lower limbs with white horizontal bands above the dark carpal/tarsal joints.
